minimum_threshold: All five operational conditions PASS on project-level evidence: Australian jurisdiction; georeferenced location; formal independent project/development unit; explicit REE primary/co-product/planned recovery by-product/development target; exploration/resource assessment/development stage. Require at least one government/tenure source and one formal technical/project disclosure, with source date and project relation recorded. Resolve material duplicate conflicts before promotion.
effect: Eligible for MCDA candidate-list review after reviewer sign-off; not automatically admitted.

minimum_threshold: Any required condition is unknown, evidence is only an occurrence/mineral indication, planned REE recovery is not evidenced, project-vs-deposit unit is unresolved, tenure/source coverage is missing, or contradictory identity/ownership evidence remains.
effect: Retain in audit queue; do not score or silently discard.

minimum_threshold: Positive evidence establishes failure of a mandatory condition (outside Australian jurisdiction; no project-level REE role; no qualifying exploration/resource/development unit; or only a deposit/occurrence child with no independent project identity). Record the failed condition and evidence, then require human review.
effect: Exclude from project candidate table but retain raw/source IDs and lineage.

minimum_threshold: Require authoritative project alias/parent-child disclosure, exact government project code/tenement relationship, or at least two independent matching identifiers including geography/tenure plus project/company evidence. Exact name/string match alone is only a candidate link.
effect: Preserve all original IDs; record parent Project, child Deposit/Prospect/Tenement and merge evidence.
